content: Navar leaves a note in giant for <@264570136025890816> ||"i heard about the cloak. I wanted to come in last night and talk about it but my attention was also needed elsewhere in our search. It sounds like it is a progression of the curse you have for reading the contract and I do not fault you for that. This is why I fear for you should you have chosen to sign it, you would likely lose yourself. When we arrive at the mantapolis we will find more about bringing the gods back. We have allies and they should be our comfort. Ilmater would not have you take shortcuts to your goals just as chauntea would not have an idler.||
Navar returns to the room thinking about wynne and the mysteries of the night before. So much overheard but little truly understood.(is note just like squirming in bed or is he obviously awake?)

Astella wakes to blood in the sheets. Immediately, they’re embarrassed, but they realize it’s Cato’s scab.
*How did that happen...?*
They heal what they can with *cure wounds*
Kissing him on the forehead, they get up, but notice Wynne - who now looks a lot like them.
They stand, in shock, watching Wynne sleep.
"Astella. It is going to be a dark day. Stay safe my dear. Do not be alone, trust 🎵. Florian will have answers for you."
“Where can I find Florian?”
"He is in the aft observation deck. Mention I trust you and he will fill you in. He may question you still."

“I... Wynne... Wynne... this is not good...” They flashback to the countless times their father made deals that turned normal people into horned, winged servants, and the crying anguish in their eyes...

Navar leaves a note in elvish for <@297577343554158603> ||"thank you for your aid. With the mantapolis close we have great hope and i am grateful for the hope you have given us with your pure heart. We believe this to be a gravesite from the day of the black sun, florian believes it may hold secrets on how to save them. You are blessed by melora and have proven stronger than any priest or zealot. If you call, I will be your shield."||
"No it is not. You should mention that to Florian as well."
Wynne sits up in their bed. “Didn’t make a pact.”
They nod absentmindedly to Cato as they slowly approach Wynne, kiss them on the forehead.
"Made a mistake rather."
*My fears were right...*
Cato notices his paw is healed but doesn't want to discuss it yet
*I knew a child couldn’t be trusted with a scroll of such power, not an outsider child...*
Kiln awakens early and stretches as big as she can. She takes up her Tome and a quill to begin writing a letter.
(It was healed by tech, so it was stitched shut and will have a scar)
They shrug, still looking tired. “Don’t even have the scroll.”
*How could I have been so careless for a friend like this? How could I have not intervened..?*
Astella darts out of the room.
They grab their cloak. “... Cato. My knight’s crest is back.”
Astella comes into the room, panicked and almost crying - which isn’t common, “Hello? Florian?!”
"You must still talk to Florian."
"Welcome back though Sir Wynne." He says will a small smile
Her letter written, she stamps it with the symbol of Osiris, and heads off to deliver it.

A dejected Traxim enters the lodge and begins to look for a yeti. They tend to stand out so he could only assume that not seeing one meant there were none present. Traxim sits down and starts writing on some paper.

```Archivist Daysong,
 I was unable to complete my mission yesterday due to Brother Rah’s murder. I did get a chance to spy on the one Sister Kiln warmed us about but they said nothing incriminating.

Traxim```

(had to wake up for irl stuff, just lightly catching up, going to be going back to sleep. Will be back awake in a few hours, before noon at the latest. Got a big DnD day today so gotta pace myself. Assume Florian is asleep)
Astella answerlessly collapses by the door.
*I could’ve stopped this. I tried! I should’ve tried harder, and now Wynne pays for my insolence.*
They let out a scream, getting mad that they have a tail, and horns, and wings, “**Why?**”
Wynne covers themself back up with the blanket. Fyr runs out of the room.
They get close to ripping things off, but some biological restraint prevents them. Their red markings around their body are glowing, and their turret is scanning the area around them on guard.
They’re sobbing.

Best of luck ta all my Siblings in tha Mason's.

He sits by them "I'm worried about them too. But it is important to have faith in them. They are knights, and have more honor than most civil folk will have in a lifetime. The best we can do is support them when plans don't go right
*He doesn’t understand... He doesn’t know...*
They remain silent, trying to shut you out and let them suffer as they should
Navars demeanor shifts as he reads the pain in her face "by what power do you have control to have changed this?"
"Knowledge." Their voice is strangely distorted. As if speaking without masking their infernal accent. It sounds booming, but hollow.

"And what good would it do if they didn't listen? People are not tools, they decide for themselves. As much as you would think you could have changed an outcome, you shoukd stay humble in the fact that you didn't. Self pity solves nothing." He knocks on his chest over his symbol
*He doesn't understand.*

"You don't understand that it's better to recognize you're powerless to change events than to fool yourseld into thinking you're the answer. Tell me, what would you have done? They even said to themselves, it was just thinking aloud."
"I gave in. I could've stopped Wynne, but I gave in because I was afraid to hurt them or disagree. I chose friendship and love over safety."

content: Ozgur is working in the Cargo bay, humming his usual tune, enjoying the greenery, when he freezes, dropping the crate he is carrying and staring at the mysterious 4x4 foot opening in the wall. Ozgur looks around the room wondering if anyone's noticed this besides him.

(Gotcha, keeping that in mind moving forward) "That's admitting you lacked the power to change it. Even I'm dissappointed in myself for that, but it will be better to work together in fixing it rather than meaningless tears."
"You don't understand. This has happened before, right before my eyes."
(It's like the kid crying under the blanket, you know they're upset and you can read the room on a couple things.)
"I have lived for 442 years. Try me. Many have blamed themselves for others mistakes."

"Yes, but many are to blame for others' mistakes as well. My father... he was a devil. I was convinced for so long that he was a hero, but he enslaved people, tricking them into becoming winged, horned servants."

"I knew that contract. Or something like it. I warned Wynne, but I quickly apologized because they're my friend and I valued that friendship more than their life. I shouldn't have been so... so *malleable*."

He puts a hand on their wings. It's coarse from a life of labor but for his size and build the touch is gentle. "Then realize you had said your peace. They are not a slave yet, and with hope the mantapolis will be able to aid us. You respected the choice of a friend, there is no shame it that. You do not carry the sins of others, your own are heavy enough."
(Love him)
(Well that was quite the backhanded insult)
(-1 charisma baby)
(He means so well)
(It just be like that he truly cares but tact is not something he's been able to learn)
"I still carry guilt. Not for Wynne alone, but Wynne is a member of the masses I've stood by and let suffer because of my cracked moral compass."
Navar sighs and stays with them. Not saying any more but keeps up an understanding presence.
(upkeep and keep up have different meanings)
After a long silence, Astella asks, "What's it like..? To be a knight?"
Adrian awakens, he tidied his things up, makes his bunk, then starts some sketching of human anatomy.

He thinks for a moment. "I suppose it's different to each knight. I used to only know them as servants of a crown and the civil folks steel protectors. But after I met florian at the chateau that changed. It didn't feel that I was swearing to a man or taking a fake mantle of righteousness. It felt like roots were made, that my heart could breathe like it did in the presence of my lady."
"I'm not particularly religious... not after Rome turned on us..."
Navar shrugs "my oath is not to the order, it's to the good people and virtues it stands for. I understand many feel distant from the gods, there is no fault in that."
"What does it take?"
"I don't know if everyone in the knighthood has to be sworn to the gods, but none should argue that your intentions and heart are anything less than good. Unless of course those are false tears."
"I can't cry on command."
"Then you have nothing to worry about."
"How do I join?"
"You can speak to florian, I think i hear him in <#636019698340855818> . We may have found mantapolis." He holds a hand out. "Care to join us in looking?"
"I'd like that."
Navar feels like he'll get shanked for saying something wrong someday
Baeshra understands.
